workarounds.symptom: [Feature] 优化 AstrBot MCP 重连机制的问题
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): recover broken sessions and initial connections. Target files: astrbot/core/agent/mcp_client.py. An MCP server can be unavailable at startup, or its session can disappear between calls. The client should try a fresh connection before giving up, and should not replace the original tool error when recovery fails. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/10838)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] LogPipe 按平台默认编码解码子进程 stderr，一条非 ASCII 日志会静默冻死 MCP 工具调用
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): decode subprocess stderr robustly. Target files: astrbot/core/utils/log_pipe.py. A child process must be able to keep writing stderr even when its encoding differs from the host or one log line fails to forward. If the drain thread exits, a full pipe can block the child and make every MCP tool call time out. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/10982)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] MCP tools never register with mcp>=2.x: the 180s timeout hides an AttributeError
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): reject unsupported mcp SDK major versions. Target files: astrbot/core/agent/mcp_client.py, astrbot/core/provider/func_tool_manager.py, tests/unit/test_func_tool_manager.py. An incompatible MCP SDK or an invalid tool schema should produce its real error immediately, not a server initialization timeout with the cause hidden. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/10825)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]在查询的时候提示：未找到指定的工具: astr_kb_searchastr_kb_search，将跳过。
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(openai): normalize streamed tool call identity. Target files: astrbot/core/provider/sources/openai_source.py, tests/test_openai_source.py. Related: #7694, #6661. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/10703)

workarounds.symptom: Traces of cron/Scheduler-originated events remain "running" forever; trace state is stored twice and can diverge
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(trace): use indexed state and flags in trace history responses. Target files: astrbot/core/utils/trace_store.py, tests/unit/test_trace_store.py. The trace history API filters and counts rows using the indexed SQLite columns (`state`, `has_errors`, `has_models`, `has_plugins`), but previously returned the corresponding fields from the serialized `traces.data` snapshot. If the indexed columns and JSON snapshot diverge, the list and detail endpoints can display stale state or flags, contradicting the active filters. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/11339)

workarounds.symptom: 禁用后重新启用插件时 resolve_view 早于 activated 更新，报 The view's plugin is unavailable
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(plugin): resolve views after updating the activated flag. Target files: astrbot/core/star/star_manager.py. Re-enabling a plugin that declares `views` in its metadata fails to load: (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/11306)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] 决策模型协议 SystemOne 的 noul 类型请求未兼容标准格式
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(provider): support optional System One boolean criteria. Target files: astrbot/core/provider/entities.py, astrbot/core/provider/provider.py, astrbot/core/provider/sources/system_one_decision_source.py. The System One–compatible endpoint reported in #10920 requires both `true` and `false` in `noul.criteria`. AstrBot's connection test omits `criteria`, so the endpoint returns HTTP 400. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/11062)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] openrouter 适配器非流式模式下丢失思考内容：reasoning_details 数组未解析（GLM-5.3-Flash 等受影响）
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve OpenRouter reasoning details in non-streaming replies. Target files: astrbot/core/provider/sources/openrouter_source.py. OpenRouter can return non-streaming reasoning in a `reasoning_details` array instead of the flat `message.reasoning` field. The adapter now reads the text and summary entries when the flat field is absent or empty. It keeps the provider order, skips encrypted and malformed entries, and preserves the existing flat-field and streaming behavior. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/11168)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] DashScope TTS 无法调用 qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus 模型，返回 InvalidParameter: url error
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: support Qwen-Audio-TTS in DashScope provider. Target files: astrbot/core/config/default.py, astrbot/core/provider/sources/dashscope_tts.py, dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en-US/features/config-metadata.json. - Route Qwen-Audio-TTS models through the existing `SpeechSynthesizer` implementation instead of `MultiModalConversation`. - Add an optional, instance-local WebSocket endpoint setting while preserving the SDK default when it is blank. - Add Chinese, Japanese, English, and Russian translations, regression coverage, ... (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/10495)
